color.note: Three tiers: core → semantic → component. Core tokens hold raw, theme-stable values. Semantic tokens name a role and pick a core token per theme. Component tokens alias a semantic token and are the only tokens a component reads. Media tokens never flip: video, shorts and manga stay dark in both themes.

tokens.name: neutral-base
